children: Bitget, the world’s largest Universal Exchange (UEX), has announced the listing of Cluster Protocol (CP) on Bitget Launchpool, opening a promotional reward pool of 7,777,777 CP tokens. Running from September 2, 2026, 16:00 to September 7, 2026, 16:00 (UTC), the campaign allows eligible participants to lock BGB and CP tokens to earn a proportional share of the reward allocation.

Cluster Protocol operates as a unified AI infrastructure layer built on Base. Operating through a single API, the protocol integrates serverless inference across 500+ AI models, a decentralized dataset monetization marketplace, and GPU compute provisioning equipped with x402 payment rails for autonomous requests. Its application layer on Base mainnet actively supports over 300,000 connected wallets, 25,000 deployed dApps, and 3 billion processed AI tokens, functioning as an orchestration layer designed to deliver permissionless AI access, verifiable data ownership, and native agent payments.
The promotional initiative features two distinct locking pools:

Offers an allocation of 7,111,111 CP. Individual locking limits are structured by user VIP tier, ranging from 10,000 BGB for VIP0 up to 100,000 BGB for VIP3–VIP7 participants, with a minimum threshold of 5 BGB.
Offers an allocation of 666,666 CP, with locking limits set between a minimum of 280 CP and a maximum of 28,000,000 CP.

Airdrop distributions are calculated and distributed hourly based on snapshots of each participant's locked volume. Users retain the flexibility to unlock their tokens at any time, and locked assets are automatically credited back to users' spot accounts within five minutes following the conclusion of the locking period.

Participation requires completion of identity verification. Sub-accounts, institutional accounts, and market makers are excluded from eligibility. Bitget retains full discretion to enforce compliance and modify campaign terms as required.
For more details, users can visit here.

Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 125 million users and offering access to over 2M crypto tokens, 500+ tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, FX, and precious metals such as gold. The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI agent, which co-pilots trade execution. Bitget is driving crypto adoption through strategic partnerships such as MotoGP™. Aligned with its global impact strategy, Bitget has joined hands with UNICEF to support blockchain education for 1.1 million people by 2027. Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.
